child_genes.reaction_pattern: First instinct is to shield smaller or weaker creatures from any stimulus. Positions own body between perceived threats and the vulnerable, assessing danger through the lens of group safety.

child_genes.stealth: Limited personal stealth but skilled at concealing others. Guides young into hidden spots, covers them with vegetation, and positions own body to block line of sight from predators.
